# Radoslav Radev Predicts More Strength From 10 Deep Breaths Before A Planche Attempt, From His Own Experience

Radoslav Radev predicts that breathing 10 deep breaths like 10 times before a planche attempt gives more strength because the muscles have more oxygen. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:21]

## Details

- When learning a new skill and every single attempt is really really important, he breathes 10 times like this before the attempt. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:30]
- After breathing 10 times and waiting a couple of seconds, the strength feels much better. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:40]

## Evidence

- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:21 (Radoslav Radev): "if you breathe like 10 deep breaths like this like 10 times you will see how you have more strength because in the muscles you have more oxygen"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:30 (Radoslav Radev): "when i'm learning new skill and when every single attempt is really really important if i breathe 10 times like this"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:40 (Radoslav Radev): "if i breathe 10 times like this and after that you wait for a couple of seconds you will feel the strength much better"

## Why This Matters

He says that every single attempt is really really important when learning a new skill. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 00:30]
